waivers.rationale: df3-03-02/i1 (division-fluency-g3, 'why does 7 ÷ 0 have no answer?') is the sole conceptual/definitional lesson in the paired mult-fluency-g3 / division-fluency-g3 courses (see NO_FACT_LESSONS and the UNVARIANTED_OK comment in src/lib/session186.fluencyPair.test.ts) — every other lesson in both 24-lesson courses uses the areaModel manipulative (manip-tier DIRECT) for i1/i2, which is why they clear this check for free. Division by zero has no areaModel (or any other manipulative) representation — there is nothing to drag or build that models 'no number works' — so the lesson uses mcq for both interactive steps, same as its own i2. The i1.predict block itself is not optional: S241 WS-E Phase 4 explicitly ruled it must be present and coherent for every lesson not on the S241_REMOVED list, and df3-03-02 is not on that list. Repairing this warning by forcing a manipulative widget onto a divide-by-zero question would add manipulation for the linter's sake, not the learner's — a worse lesson, not a better one.
